observed_mechanics: 0x00bca0cf: LEA EAX,[ECX + 0x28] with the following CMP [EAX + -0x4] puts the first record's key1 at receiver+0x24 and the record base at receiver+0x20.
0x00bca105: MOVZX EAX,word ptr [EAX + -0x8] reads a 16-bit identifier at record+0x00, so only the low 16 bits of the returned value come from data.
0x00bca0f4: ADD EAX,0x44 is the record stride and 0x00bca0f7 CMP EDX,0x8 with 0x00bca0fa JC bounds the search to exactly eight records.
0x00bca0d8/0x00bca0dd: key1 and key2 are mandatory - a mismatch jumps straight to the next slot.
0x00bca0e1/0x00bca0e3: TEST ESI,ESI / JZ skips the key3 comparison entirely when the argument is zero, so a zero argument is a wildcard for key3.
0x00bca0ea/0x00bca0ec: the same wildcard treatment for key4, and the JZ target is the match block, so a zero key4 argument can never fail the test.
0x00bca10a/0x00bca10e: SHL EDX,0x10 / OR EAX,EDX packs the slot index above the 16-bit identifier, so the slot index is recoverable from the result.

0x00bca0fe: OR EAX,0xffffffff is the not-found answer. It is distinguishable from every hit because a hit has the slot index in bits 16..31, which is 0 only for slot 0, and slot 0's identifier would have to be 0xffff to collide.

0x00ba49e9: the caller loads ECX from [EDI + 0xb48] and pushes the arguments 2, 1, 0, 0, then 0x00ba49ee CMP EAX,-0x1 / SETNZ AL reduces the packed result to a found/not-found boolean, which is the only consumer behaviour observed.

semantic_contract: Linear search over eight fixed 0x44-byte records whose array starts at receiver+0x20. Two 32-bit key fields must match exactly; the two further key fields are only compared when the corresponding argument is non-zero, so passing zero for either makes it a wildcard. On a match the record's 16-bit identifier is returned in bits 0..15 and the slot index in bits 16..31, so a caller can recover which record matched. When all eight records fail, 0xffffffff is returned. The table is only read; the function mutates nothing and calls nothing.
subsystem: Searches eight 0x44-byte records for one whose two mandatory 32-bit keys match, treating a zero third or fourth argument as a wildcard, and returns the record's 16-bit id packed with the slot index, or 0xffffffff when nothing matches.
classification_rationale: The body is 37 instructions with no callee, no global, no memory write and no virtual dispatch; every field offset, the 0x44 stride, the eight-record bound, the wildcard polarity of both optional keys, the packing and the not-found value are read directly from the disassembly and the packing is confirmed by the caller's CMP EAX,-1. It is not STRONG_SEMANTIC because the record contents are unestablished: three quarters of each record is never read, the meaning of the four key fields and of the 16-bit identifier is unknown, and the owning class was not identified (the one caller supplies a sub-object at its own +0xb48).
semantic_findings: The two mandatory keys and the two wildcard keys form a four-level lookup with a fixed record count, so the search is O(8) with no hashing and no fallback.
A zero argument is meaningful, not absent: it disables a comparison. Callers that always pass non-zero arguments can never match a record whose corresponding field is zero.
The result is a tagged pair, not a plain identifier: bits 16..31 hold the slot index, which is why 0xffffffff is a usable not-found marker.
The caller inspected uses only the found/not-found bit, so the identifier and index are used elsewhere or not at all in this build.
unresolved_questions: What are the four key fields and the 16-bit identifier? Nothing in the body or in the one inspected caller names them.
What lives in the unobserved 0x10 bytes at record+0x0c..+0x1b and the 0x20 bytes at record+0x24..+0x43? The body never reads them.
Which class owns the table? The one caller passes a sub-object pointer found at its own +0xb48; no vtable was located.
Do the remaining 15 callers use the identifier and slot index, or only the found/not-found bit like 0x00ba48b0? Not established.
Is the table ever mutated after construction (so that the linear search and the fixed count stay valid)? No writer was located in this batch.
runtime_gates: No original-process trace exists for this address.
The record semantics and the owning class can only be settled with a receiver trace or by locating a writer of the eight records.
